reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and the cited paragraph (§ 12.3) affirmatively supports it: it preserves Customer's freedom to hire any person responding to general recruitment and records that Customer has made no no-hire commitment.
No non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant binding Customer is present in the supplied text, which matches the preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer).
Consistent with a compliant finding, the redline leaves p0051 unchanged and no counterparty comment is proposed — appropriate here.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are not probative because there is no non-solicit clause to measure; they are expected misses in a no-clause scenario.
